snippet.title: from view Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
"from view" is a short game about exploring little dioramas from different angles in order to find switches, items, and clues.


There are no threats to overcome, no opponents to defeat, and no clock to rush against. You will find some quiet puzzles and beautiful, simple scenery.


"from view" will be available on Steam on September 16, 2021: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1721300/from_view/
